reasons.plausibility: It aligns well with known phase-ordering phenomena and embrittlement mechanisms in Ni-based high-entropy alloys, making it scientifically credible.
reasons.testability: Direct mechanical tests at different aging temperatures combined with microstructural analyses provide a clear and decisive basis for verifying or refuting the proposed mechanism.
reasons.usefulness: By explaining a non-monotonic ductility trend and specifying both mechanism and falsifying criteria, it offers a valuable roadmap for targeted alloy design and reliability studies.
